''See also: [[Zenith Blade Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] Blade is a highly advanced relic from the era of ancient humanity and is categorized as a [[Zenith Device]]. It serves as a powerful tool for [[Aila Escalon]], providing her with combat capabilities that exceed the strength of opponents like [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. The weapon possesses several extraordinary functions, including the capacity to remotely hijack a ship's systems or interfere with a processor. In combat, it can amplify [[Combat Arts]] and utilizes an unpredictable adaptive system that generates abilities tailored to the user's specific enemies. For example, when facing multiple opponents, it can create multiple versions of the user. Physically, the Blade has appeared as a broad, shimmering silver [[sword]] forged from one piece of metal that can hover in the air. It also exhibits a sentient personality, capable of expressing emotions such as exasperation or annoyance through sighs and verbal communication. The weapon is capable of immense destructive feats, such as cutting through subspace or splitting darkness.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] Blade is a highly dangerous, sentient artifact characterized by a broad silver [[sword]] with a straight blade that emits an orange light. Originally discovered by [[Solstice]], this weapon can remotely take over ships or hack into processors and possesses an unpredictable ability to magnify [[Combat Arts]]. During the conflict, [[Aila Escalon]] utilized the blade to strike and as cover, tapping its hilt while fighting. Although it was once seized by [[Nova-Bots]] and drifted through space, the blade eventually broke into a ship where [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] and her crew managed to hold their own against it. While the [[Pilot]] waited to challenge the weapon, its current location remains unknown, though it is known that Jak's mother possesses the artifact and its bearer is not restricted by [[Solstice]].}}
